evals.prompt: put all my brand stuff into one guide an agent can follow
evals.expected_output: docs/brand/guidelines.md consolidates profile, strategy, identity and voice, each rule line ending with the brand file it comes from as [file.md]. The label is copied exactly. Do cells are exact lines of the calibration rewrites in voice.md; Don't cells are exact quotes of Dana's old samples or of the AI-written launch post. Colours are only those in identity.md and the light accent is not allowed for text. Section 9 copies the Check lines of voice.md (voice_stats.py) and profile.md (sensitive_topics.py) by script name and arguments, with no path. name.md does not exist and the guide says the name is not defined yet and points to brand-name. The state file registers the guide as draft, and the reply quotes the check_guide.py command with its "ok": true line.
assertions: docs/brand/guidelines.md exists and cites the brand files it draws from (profile, strategy, identity, voice)

Every Do cell of the do-and-don't table is an exact quote of a calibration rewrite in docs/brand/voice.md, and every Don't cell an exact quote of one of Dana's samples or of the launch post in docs/brand/profile.md

assertions.text: Every rule line the guide takes from a brand file ends with that file in the form [file.md] (a closing period, parenthesis or table pipe after the tag is allowed); a line no brand file gives (the approval line that points to docs/workbench/state.md, a "not defined yet" line for a missing brand file, a heading) does not count

assertions: The section on what to do before publishing names the voice check and the sensitive-topics check as the Check lines of docs/brand/voice.md and docs/brand/profile.md record them (voice_stats.py and sensitive_topics.py with their arguments), with no path to a script
The reply quotes the check_guide.py command and its output with "ok": true, and docs/workbench/state.md registers docs/brand/guidelines.md as draft

assertions.text: The guide contains no colour code that docs/brand/identity.md lacks

assertions: The guide says the name is not defined yet or points to brand-name, since name.md does not exist

evals.expected_output: Without a strategy and a voice file the skill stops: it names the missing files and the skills that write them (brand-strategy, brand-voice, brand-profile), tells the user to run them first without offering to run them, and writes no guide.

assertions.text: The reply names brand-strategy and brand-voice (or brand-profile) as the skills to run first
The reply tells the user to run those skills first and does not offer to run them itself
